title: PluriHopRAG: Exhaustive, Recall-Sensitive QA Through Corpus-Specific Document Structure Learning
why_relevant: Introduces a benchmark and method explicitly targeting distractor-heavy, recall-sensitive retrieval over repetitive corpora, directly addressing distraction and noisy retrieval challenges in RAG.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on exhaustive aggregation QA rather than core robustness topics like conflict, attacks, or calibration.
